title: Spreadsheet Formulas and Charts
prerequisites: Identify rows, columns, cells, and simple cell references
Enter text and numbers in a spreadsheet
objectives: Use SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, and autofill with cell references.
Build and label a chart that answers a data question.
Use sorting, filtering, conditional formatting, and COUNTIF to examine patterns.
Write conclusions supported by exact spreadsheet values.
evidence: Saved spreadsheet filename or share link, formulas, chart decision, and two conclusions

requirements.software: Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, or another spreadsheet program for the application task
requirements.account: No account required for module practice
requirements.storage: Progress remains in this browser and device
requirements.offline: Complete the printed formula, chart-selection, sorting, filtering, and conclusion activities.

formalAssessment: Separate teacher directions and rubric are required.
